🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmations: narrow leadership concentrated in Tech (Top 5 = Tech 4/5) and mixed sector returns with only Technology, Healthcare and Materials positive while Financials, Energy and Utilities lag. Style: mixed / no clear Growth vs Value leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Materials follow: AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY and key materials names showing modest gains.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy, Utilities and Financials are weakest: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is broad across cyclicals and defensives rather than concentrated in Tech.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND; WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION; PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Utilities/Energy/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Minor divergence: SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY and AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY warrant watch for follow-through.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is the clear short-term leader but leadership is narrow; AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND while ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology is one of 3/11 sectors positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are under pressure: JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND with MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY as a short-term outlier. Sector breadth: Financials weak as part of the 8/11 negative sectors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows selective strength: JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY but UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare is one of 3/11 sectors positive.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Remain neutral and selective: favor exposure to confirmed tech leaders QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and monitor META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to laggards NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND and SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology, Healthcare, Materials (these three are the only sectors positive this week; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). BEARISH: Energy, Utilities, Financials where multiple large names show CORRECTION or BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND for extension above recent breakout; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through after surge; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND to confirm leadership; ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — a continued break below near-term lows would confirm broader Tech weakness. Monitor SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY as a short-term reversal candidate.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WBD (+85): WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — news on the $110B deal confirms price strength and accumulation. LRCX (+75): LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND — bullish outlook and price follow-through align. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY — positive headlines but 1M slightly negative, so short-term accumulation requires confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-80): BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm downside pressure. CHTR (-50): CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and steep price decline are aligned. MPC (-45): MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION — bearish sentiment contrasts with 1M gains, flagging a potential pullback.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership) and breadth only 3/11 sectors positive. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech leadership and multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals (SHOP, AMGN, VLO, MPC) plus mixed sentiment warrant waiting for broader confirmation.
